== English Death Star II comparison ==
The Players Committee first published the piloting requirement as an Appendix B ruling on [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1036946#p1036946 31 May 2016]. The 2 August 2022 announcement placed the requirement in the replacement text and removed the earlier ruling. The other clauses and printed attributes agree across the verified images.
